bmi.title: BMI Calculator Online — Free
bmi.description: Calculate Body Mass Index (BMI) from weight and height, then review the result against common international weight categories.
bmi.tip: A BMI between 18.5–24.9 is considered normal.
bmi.seo_step_3: Click Calculate to see your BMI and health category
bmi.seo_formula: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height² (m). For example, 70 kg and 1.75 m gives 70 ÷ 1.75² = 22.86. Common WHO categories are underweight < 18.5, normal 18.5-24.9, overweight 25-29.9, and obese ≥ 30.
bmi.seo_faq_1_a: A BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered normal by WHO guidelines.
bmi.seo_faq_2_a: BMI is a useful first screening tool, but it does not separate muscle from fat or account for age, sex, pregnancy, or body composition. Athletes and older adults may need additional measurements.
bmi.seo_faq_3_q: What should I do if my BMI is outside the normal range?
bmi.seo_faq_3_a: Consult a healthcare professional for personalized advice. BMI is a starting point, not a diagnosis.

unit.title: Unit Converter Online — Free
unit.description: Convert common measurement units for length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and speed using standard conversion factors.
unit.seo_step_1: Select a category (Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, or Speed)
unit.seo_step_2: Enter the value to convert and select the source unit
unit.seo_step_3: Select the target unit — the result appears instantly
unit.seo_formula: All conversions use standard factors such as 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 1 kg = 2.20462 lb, and 1 mile = 1.60934 km. Temperature uses direct formulas: °C to °F = (°C × 9/5) + 32 and °C to K = °C + 273.15.
unit.seo_faq_1_a: Length, Weight, Temperature, Area, Volume, and Speed — covering the most commonly needed conversions.
unit.seo_faq_2_a: All conversions use internationally accepted factors with high precision.
unit.seo_faq_3_a: Yes, negative values are fully supported for Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin conversions.

age.title: Age Calculator Online — Free
age.description: Calculate exact age from a birth date in years, months, and days, including the next birthday date.
age.seo_step_2: Set the reference date (defaults to today)
age.seo_step_3: Click Calculate to see your exact age in years, months, and days
age.seo_formula: Age is calculated by counting the elapsed years, months, and days from your birth date to the reference date. Leap years and varying month lengths are handled automatically for an exact result.
age.seo_faq_1_q: How accurate is this age calculator?
age.seo_faq_1_a: It calculates your exact age down to the day, accounting for leap years and months of different lengths.
age.seo_faq_2_q: Can I calculate age on a future or past date?
age.seo_faq_2_a: Yes, just change the reference date to any date you need — past or future.
age.seo_faq_3_a: It shows the exact date of your next upcoming birthday and how many days away it is.

currency.title: Currency Converter Online — Free
currency.description: Convert between world currencies using the latest available exchange rates, with fallback rates when live data is unavailable.
currency.approximate_rates: Using approximate rates (could not fetch real-time data)
currency.seo_step_1: Enter the amount you want to convert
currency.seo_step_3: Select the target currency — the result appears instantly
currency.seo_formula: Converted amount = input amount × exchange rate. Rates are fetched from a live API and updated regularly. If live rates are unavailable, approximate fallback rates are used.
currency.seo_faq_1_a: The app attempts to fetch the latest rates from an API and shows the update time. If the request fails, fallback approximate rates are used, so always confirm with your bank before a real transaction.
currency.seo_faq_2_a: Over 150 world currencies are supported, including major and minor currencies.
currency.seo_faq_3_q: Can I swap source and target currencies?
currency.seo_faq_3_a: Yes, click the swap button between the two currency selectors to instantly reverse the conversion.

loan.title: Loan Calculator Online — Free
loan.description: Calculate monthly loan payments, total interest, and total repayment from principal, annual interest rate, and loan term.
loan.seo_step_2: Enter the annual interest rate as a percentage
loan.seo_step_3: Enter the loan term in months
loan.seo_step_4: Click Calculate to see monthly payment, total payment, and total interest
loan.seo_formula: Monthly Payment = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n − 1], where P = principal, r = monthly rate (annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100), and n = number of months. Payments stay level, but early payments contain more interest while later payments reduce principal faster.
loan.seo_faq_1_a: It is the fixed amount you pay each month, covering both principal repayment and interest.
loan.seo_faq_2_a: Total interest = (monthly payment × number of months) − principal.
loan.seo_faq_3_q: Can I use this for mortgage or car loans?
loan.seo_faq_3_a: Yes. The same amortization formula applies to all loan types — personal loans, car loans, and mortgages.

percentage.title: Percentage Calculator Online — Free
percentage.description: Calculate common percentage problems including X% of Y, percentage increase or decrease, ratios, and discounts.
percentage.seo_step_1: Select a mode: 'X% of Y', 'Percentage Change', or 'Ratio Percentage'
percentage.seo_step_2: Enter the required values in the fields
percentage.seo_step_3: Click Calculate to see the result
percentage.seo_formula: X% of Y = (X ÷ 100) × Y. Percentage change = ((new − old) ÷ old) × 100. Ratio percentage = (part ÷ whole) × 100. A positive change means increase; negative means decrease.
percentage.seo_faq_1_q: How do I calculate a discount?
percentage.seo_faq_1_a: Use 'X% of Y' mode: enter the discount percentage as X and the original price as Y. The result is the discount amount.
percentage.seo_faq_2_a: It measures how much a value increased or decreased relative to the original value, expressed as a percentage.
percentage.seo_faq_3_a: It calculates what fraction a part is of the whole, as a percentage. For example, 30 out of 50 = 60%.

calorie.title: Calorie Calculator Online — Free
calorie.description: Estimate BMR and TDEE from sex, age, weight, height, activity level, and weight goal.
calorie.seo_step_1: Select your gender and enter your age
calorie.seo_step_4: Select your goal and click Calculate
calorie.seo_formula: Uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation: BMR (men) = 10W + 6.25H − 5A + 5; BMR (women) = 10W + 6.25H − 5A − 161. TDEE = BMR × activity factor. Goal adjusts by ±500 kcal.
calorie.seo_faq_1_a: TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) is the total calories your body needs per day, based on your activity level.
calorie.seo_faq_2_a: BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate) is the calories your body burns at complete rest just to maintain vital functions.
calorie.seo_faq_3_q: How accurate is this calorie calculator?
calorie.seo_faq_3_a: It uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, a practical estimate for most adults. Real needs can vary with muscle mass, sleep, medication, medical conditions, and activity consistency, so use it as a starting point and track results for 2-4 weeks.

date.title: Date Calculator Online — Free
date.description: Calculate calendar days and business days between two dates, or find a new date by adding or subtracting days.
date.seo_step_1: Choose a mode: 'Days between dates' or 'Add / subtract days'
date.seo_step_2: Enter the relevant dates or number of days
date.seo_step_3: Click Calculate to see the result
date.seo_formula: For date differences, the tool counts total calendar days and business days (Mon–Fri, excluding weekends) between two dates. In add/subtract mode, it offsets the base date by the specified number of days.
date.seo_faq_1_a: Business days are weekdays (Monday to Friday), excluding Saturdays and Sundays. Public holidays are not factored in.
date.seo_faq_2_q: Can I calculate past or future dates?
date.seo_faq_2_a: Yes, there is no date range restriction. You can calculate any past or future date.
date.seo_faq_3_q: Can I subtract days from a date?
date.seo_faq_3_a: Yes, in 'Add / subtract days' mode, enter a negative number to go backwards in time.

sleep.title: Sleep Calculator Online — Free
sleep.description: Calculate suggested bedtimes or wake-up times from 90-minute sleep cycles, including average time to fall asleep.
sleep.mode_bedtime: I want to wake up at...
sleep.mode_wake: I want to go to bed at...
sleep.tip: The body sleeps in 90-minute cycles. Waking at the end of a cycle feels more refreshing.
sleep.seo_step_1: Select a mode: enter your desired wake-up time or bedtime
sleep.seo_step_2: Enter the time you want to wake up or go to bed
sleep.seo_step_3: See a list of recommended times based on 90-minute sleep cycles
sleep.seo_formula: Sleep is structured in 90-minute cycles of light sleep, deep sleep, and REM sleep. Waking at the end of a cycle feels more refreshing than mid-cycle. The calculator adds 14 minutes for average sleep onset time.
sleep.seo_faq_1_a: A sleep cycle lasts approximately 90 minutes and includes light sleep, deep slow-wave sleep, and REM sleep stages.
sleep.seo_faq_2_q: How many sleep cycles do I need?
sleep.seo_faq_2_a: Most adults need 5–6 cycles (7.5–9 hours) for full rest. Waking between cycles feels more natural and refreshing.
sleep.seo_faq_3_a: On average, it takes about 14 minutes to fall asleep after lying down. This offset is included so the recommended times are practical.

gpa.title: GPA Calculator Online — Free
gpa.description: Calculate semester GPA and cumulative GPA from courses, credits, and grades using a common 4.0 scale.
gpa.required_course: Add at least 1 course with credits
gpa.seo_step_1: Click 'Add Course' and enter the course name, credits, and grade
gpa.seo_step_2: Repeat for all courses this semester
gpa.seo_step_3: Optionally enter your previous GPA and credits for cumulative GPA
gpa.seo_step_4: Click Calculate to see your semester GPA and cumulative GPA
gpa.seo_formula: GPA = Σ(grade points × credits) ÷ Σ(credits). Grade scale: A=4.0, B+=3.5, B=3.0, C+=2.5, C=2.0, D+=1.5, D=1.0, F=0. Cumulative GPA weights all previous semester credits too.
gpa.seo_faq_1_q: What grade scale does this use?
gpa.seo_faq_1_a: The standard Thai university 4.0 scale: A=4, B+=3.5, B=3, C+=2.5, C=2, D+=1.5, D=1, F=0.
gpa.seo_faq_2_q: How do I calculate cumulative GPA?
gpa.seo_faq_2_a: Enter your previous cumulative GPA and total credits from prior semesters. The calculator combines them with your current semester results automatically.
gpa.seo_faq_3_q: How many courses can I add?
gpa.seo_faq_3_a: There is no limit. Click 'Add Course' as many times as needed.

random_number.title: Random Number Generator — Free
random_number.description: Generate random numbers within a chosen range, choose how many results you need, and control whether duplicates are allowed.
random_number.error_range: Min must be less than Max
random_number.error_count: Count exceeds available range (no duplicates allowed)
random_number.seo_step_1: Set the minimum and maximum values for your range
random_number.seo_step_2: Choose how many random numbers to generate
random_number.seo_step_3: Toggle 'Allow duplicates' and 'Sort ascending' as needed
random_number.seo_step_4: Click Generate to get your random numbers
random_number.seo_formula: Uses a secure random algorithm for unbiased results. When duplicates are disabled, the algorithm ensures each number is unique — useful for lotteries, random draws, and fair sampling.
random_number.seo_faq_1_a: Yes, it uses a secure random algorithm. Results are unbiased and unpredictable every time.
random_number.seo_faq_2_q: Can I generate numbers without duplicates?
random_number.seo_faq_2_a: Yes, toggle off 'Allow duplicates'. The count cannot exceed the range size in this mode.
random_number.seo_faq_3_q: What can I use this for?
random_number.seo_faq_3_a: Lotteries, random team selection, sampling, games, giveaways, or any situation requiring impartial random picks.

spin_wheel.title: Spin Wheel — Custom Random
spin_wheel.description: Create a custom spin wheel from names, tasks, menus, or ideas, then spin to make a fair random choice.
spin_wheel.default_items:
Option 1

spin_wheel.add_to_see_wheel: Add items to see the wheel
spin_wheel.seo_step_1: Enter your options in the text box, one per line
spin_wheel.seo_step_3: Wait for the wheel to stop — the winning item is displayed prominently
spin_wheel.seo_formula: Each item is assigned an equal slice of the wheel. The spin duration and landing position use a random algorithm so all items have exactly equal probability of being selected.
spin_wheel.seo_faq_1_q: Can I add my own items?
spin_wheel.seo_faq_1_a: Yes, the wheel is fully customizable. Enter any items you want, one per line.
spin_wheel.seo_faq_2_a: Yes, all items have equal probability. The random algorithm is unbiased.
spin_wheel.seo_faq_3_q: How many items can I add?
spin_wheel.seo_faq_3_a: Up to 15 items is recommended for best readability, though more items can be added.

card_draw.seo_step_1: Enter your deck items in the text box, one per line
card_draw.seo_step_2: Set how many cards to draw
card_draw.seo_step_3: Click 'Draw cards!' — drawn items are removed from the remaining deck
card_draw.seo_formula: Items are drawn randomly without replacement, simulating a real draw from a shuffled deck. Drawn items are tracked separately. Use 'Reshuffle' to reset the deck and start over.
card_draw.seo_faq_1_q: Are drawn cards removed from the deck?
card_draw.seo_faq_1_a: Yes, drawn items are removed from the remaining deck, just like drawing from a real shuffled deck.
card_draw.seo_faq_2_a: Yes, click 'Reshuffle' to return all cards to the deck and start a fresh draw.
card_draw.seo_faq_3_q: What can I use Card Draw for?
card_draw.seo_faq_3_a: Team selection, secret Santa, raffle draws, game choices, or any situation requiring a fair random draw without repeats.

storage.title: Storage Converter Online — Free
storage.description: Convert data storage between Bit, Byte, KB, MB, GB, TB, and PB using the binary 1024 standard.
storage.seo_step_1: Enter the storage value you want to convert
storage.seo_step_2: Select the source unit (Bit, Byte, KB, MB, GB, TB, or PB)
storage.seo_step_3: Select the target unit — the result appears instantly
storage.seo_formula: Based on the binary (IEC) standard: 1 Byte = 8 Bits, 1 KB = 1,024 Bytes, 1 MB = 1,024 KB, 1 GB = 1,024 MB, 1 TB = 1,024 GB, 1 PB = 1,024 TB.
storage.seo_faq_1_q: Is 1 KB equal to 1000 or 1024 bytes?
storage.seo_faq_1_a: This tool uses 1024 bytes per KB (binary / IEC standard), which is what operating systems use.
storage.seo_faq_2_q: What is the difference between Bit and Byte?
storage.seo_faq_2_a: 1 Byte = 8 Bits. Bits are the smallest unit of digital data. Network speeds are typically measured in bits per second (Mbps).
storage.seo_faq_3_q: Can I convert between very different units like TB to KB?
storage.seo_faq_3_a: Yes, you can convert between any two units regardless of how far apart they are in size.
